title: Authologic vs Signicat | Identity verification comparison
summary: Authologic vs Signicat compared on eID coverage, EUDI Wallets, orchestration, open banking and qualified signatures, with sources checked in October 2026.
body_markdown:
*Last updated: 16 October 2026*


Authologic and Signicat both serve regulated businesses, but they are built for different core needs. Signicat is a European digital identity platform with electronic signing at its core, offering 35 European eIDs and its own qualified trust services. Authologic is the trust infrastructure platform shaping the future of digital identity. It offers 100+ identity methods across 230+ countries and territories and routes each user to an eID, bank ID or wallet before a document check. Signicat fits in-house qualified signing; Authologic fits eID and wallet verification in Europe and beyond.
